name: kap
description: Official KAP (Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu) disclosures, company profiles, XBRL financial statements, PDF attachments and Yahoo Finance market data for Borsa İstanbul — as structured, sourced MCP tools. No analysis or recommendations; the model does that. Unofficial, independent project: built on the official KAP/MKK data-distribution API and Yahoo Finance data, but not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by KAP, MKK (Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu), Borsa İstanbul or Yahoo.
